title: What's the biggest budget you've ever worked with?
description: What's the biggest budget you've ever worked with?
transcript: What's the biggest budget you've ever managed and what changes at that level? Biggest budget I've ever managed was spending about $600,000 a day. At that level, add creative fatigue, almost immediately you're judging results in hours, not days, certainly not weeks. So the workload required when you're spending that much goes up significantly. I mean, fortunately, if you're spending that much, it's probably because the campaigns are pulling really well, and therefore you have the money coming in to be able to pay for all the extra creative. Working with creates an influence to produce partnership ads and things along those lines. The other thing to note as well is that when you're spending that sort of budget, you are going to be reaching most likely a really large proportion of your target market really fast. So it's unlikely you're going to be able to maintain that indefinitely. So those sorts of budgets are typically seen for a week over Black Friday, Cyber Monday, or for a specific sale event, something like that. It's very rare that a business would be able to maintain a budget like that for any length of time.
